The '''Geo Beast''' was a large bipedal species, living in fiery environments.

==Biology and appearance==
Geo beasts resembled the [[Vorantikus]] of [[Voss]].<ref name="Vorantikus">{{TORcite|type=enemy|Wild Vorantikus|[[Voss]]}}</ref> Like the vorantiki, the Geo beasts had two fingers on their long hands, two toes and a back-facing claw on their feet and black stripes running across their bodies.<ref name="Hoth" /> They were covered in plating that was extremely resistant to heat. Their spleen was specialized to filter radioactive materials from their bloodstream, and was extremely similar to the spleen of a [[Trinthan prowler]] native to [[Quesh]].<ref name="Calibrations">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Good Calibrations|[[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]}}</ref> Unlike on the vorantiki, whose bony spikes ended in rounded edges,<ref name="Vorantikus" /> the spikes on Geo beasts had sharp pointy ends and were glowing with lava-like appearance along with their bodies.<ref name="Hoth" />

===Life cycle===
[[File:GeoBeastLarvae-SWTOR.png|thumb|Larva of a Geo Beast|left]]
Geo beasts started their lives as small [[Larva/Legends|larvae]] before eventually growing to enormous size as adults. The larvae possessed an additional pair of limbs, though none of the six had any developed digits. They also had a tail, which was completely reduced by the time Geo beast was reaching an adult form.<ref name="larva">{{TORcite|type=enemy|Geo Beat Larva|[[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], [[Oricon]]}}</ref>

Geo beasts' larvae were attracted to [[Fungus/Legends|fungi]],<ref name="fungalDynamic" /> even though fungi were not present in every Geo Beast habitat.<ref name="Makeb" /> 

To defend themselves, larvae of a Geo beast spited fiery substance.<ref name="larva" />

==History==
===Distribution===
Geo Beasts were abundant in the subterranean grottos of the [[Volcanic mesa|Volcanic Mesa]] on [[Makeb]]<ref name="Makeb">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=location|[[Volcanic mesa|Volcanic Mesa]]|[[Makeb]]}}</ref> and were also found on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] in the [[Molten Rift]] of the [[Glacial Fissure]], where they lived in and inside a [[Volcano/Legends|volcano]], during its activity at the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]],<ref name="Hoth" /> sometimes descending into gorges of [[Eruption Impasse]].<ref>{{TORcite|type=dynamic|Massive Geo Beast|[[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]}}</ref>

Five massive, overgrown Geo beasts were known to live on [[Voss]], near the [[Lake of the Unseen]] in the [[Nightmare Lands]]. One of them, known as [[Tittus|Tittus the Destroyer]], wandered off as far as to the [[Walk of the Masters]]. Names given to the other creatures were: [[Qusak]], [[Sorak]], [[Vitrous|Vitrous the Vile]] and [[Drumond]]. Along with other similarly named colossal creatures roaming the wilds of Voss, all five Geo beasts were targeted by hunters.<ref name="Voss">{{TORcite|type=other|Achievement: Champion of Voss}}</ref>

Among many creatures, imported and corrupted by the [[Dread Masters]], Geo beasts could be found in abundance on the moon of [[Oricon]].<ref name="Oricon" />

Several Geo beasts were present on board of the [[research vessel]] [[Jannimak]], and after its [[Crash of the Jannimak|crash]] on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] inhabited the crystal cave in the [[Geothermal Disruption]] area. Contractors of the [[Galactic Sustainability Institute]] were forcefully controlling their population there, to defend an [[Ancient Dantooinian fungus|ancient species]] of Dantooinian [[Fungus/Legends|fungi]] from Geo beast larvae.<ref name="fungalDynamic">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=dynamic|Fungal Protection|[[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]}}</ref>

===In cookery===
The [[Brain/Legends|brains]] of Geo beasts were harvested as a [[Geo Beast Brain|delicacy]] and served during the [[Feast of Prosperity/Legends|Feast of Prosperity]] event on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].<ref name="Hoth brain">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=daily|Prep Work: Larval Geo Beast Brains|[[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
In [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', the five Geo beasts of [[Voss]] are champion-level bosses, who can be killed as part of an achievement. All of them also count towards progress in an another achievement, requiring hunting [[Vorantikus|Vorantiki]].
